entry.name: tileOrder
entry.label: Tile ids in display order; merged at runtime with the known ids (new ids appended, unknown ids dropped)

entry.name: hiddenTiles
entry.label: Tile ids the user switched off

entry.name: inlineTiles
entry.label: Tile ids whose details are shown inside the card (as far as there is room) instead of only behind the card's arrow

entry.name: minCardWidth
entry.label: Minimum card width in grid units; limits how many columns the cards form

entry.name: debugLayout
entry.label: Log every layout pass and what caused it (journalctl --user -u plasma-plasmashell)

entry.name: showUnavailable
entry.label: Show dimmed cards for tiles whose hardware or service is missing, instead of hiding them

entry.name: unavailableTiles
entry.label: Internal: tile ids that were unavailable last time, for greying them in the settings

entry.name: brightnessShowOsd
entry.label: Show the brightness on-screen display when changing it from the widget

entry.name: volumeFeedback
entry.label: Play the volume feedback sound (only when built with libcanberra; also respects the audio settings)

entry.name: nightLightEnableMode
entry.label: When Night Light is disabled, the chip either enables it directly ("config") or opens its settings ("kcm")

entry.name: presentationInhibitsNightLight
entry.label: Presentation mode also suspends Night Light

entry.name: airplaneActive
entry.label: Internal: our airplane mode is on

entry.name: airplaneRestoreWifi
entry.label: Internal: Wi-Fi state before airplane mode

entry.name: airplaneRestoreWwan
entry.label: Internal: mobile broadband state before airplane mode

entry.name: airplaneRestoreBtBlocked
entry.label: Internal: Bluetooth rfkill block before airplane mode

entry.name: airplaneRestoreAdapters
entry.label: Internal: Bluetooth adapter power before airplane mode, as address=1/0
